Description (SPA): Identificador canónico de una iniciativa de la Gaceta Parlamentaria.
Description (ENG): Canonical identifier for one Gaceta Parlamentaria initiative.
Notes: Generated from legislature and the source's own sequence_number.

Description (SPA): Número secuencial de la iniciativa publicado por la fuente.
Description (ENG): Sequential initiative number published by the source.
Notes: Part of the natural key; unique within a legislature.

Description (SPA): Título o descripción de la iniciativa.
Description (ENG): Title or description of the initiative.
Notes: First line of the source entry, before any proposer/committee lines.

Description (SPA): Tipo de proponente clasificado por expresión regular.
Notes: otro means the proposer text did not match a known template; see needs_review.

Description (SPA): Nombre del legislador proponente cuando se identifica.
Notes: NULL for ejecutivo, minuta, and otro rows, and for multi-signatory initiatives the regex could not cleanly split.

Description (SPA): Grupo parlamentario del proponente cuando se identifica, tal como lo reporta la fuente.
Description (ENG): Proposer's parliamentary group, when identified, exactly as reported by the source.
Notes: Raw source text: may be a full official name, an abbreviation, or -- for multi-signatory initiatives -- contaminated with co-signer names. See proposer_party_canonical.

Description (SPA): Partido normalizado a la misma clave usada en el resto del proyecto.
Description (ENG): Party normalized to the same key used elsewhere in the project.
Values / Domain: MORENA, PAN, PRI, PRD, PVEM, PT, MC, IND, or NULL.
Notes: Derived from proposer_party by ingestion.congress_roster_ingest.canonical_party_from_text(); NULL when no recognizable party name or abbreviation was found in the source text (about 0.6% of legislador rows) -- not guessed.

Description (SPA): Texto fuente que sustenta la clasificación del proponente.
Description (ENG): Source text supporting the proposer classification.
Notes: NULL only for needs_review=1 rows, where the full entry text doesn't cleanly separate into a proposer clause.

Description (SPA): Comisión a la que fue turnada la iniciativa.
Description (ENG): Committee the initiative was referred to.
Notes: Parsed from a 'Turnada a la Comisión de...' source line; absent for some entries.

Description (SPA): Número de la Gaceta que publicó la iniciativa.
Description (ENG): Gaceta issue number that published the initiative.

Description (SPA): Fecha de publicación de la Gaceta.
Notes: Parsed from the same trailing source reference as gaceta_number and sequence_number.

Description (SPA): URL de la votación resultante cuando la iniciativa llegó a votarse.
Description (ENG): URL of the resulting vote, when the initiative reached a floor vote.
Notes: Joins exactly against dim_gaceta_vote.source_url; most initiatives never reach a vote and are NULL here.

Description (SPA): Fecha de la sección diaria de la página de origen.
Description (ENG): Date of the daily section on the source page.
Notes: The day heading the entry was listed under; may differ from gaceta_date.

Description (SPA): URL de la página de periodo de origen.
Description (ENG): URL of the source period page.

Description (SPA): Indica si el texto del proponente no coincidió con ninguna plantilla conocida.
Description (ENG): Whether the proposer text didn't match any known template.
Notes: About 4-5% of legislatura 66 rows; mostly multi-signatory joint initiatives. title is always preserved regardless.
